title: Misuzu Kaneko's birth chart
metaDescription: Misuzu Kaneko's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 20.1° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 20.1° Aries, in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 20.1° Aries. That falls in the third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Jupiter in the classical scheme — a fire sign read through a cardinal season.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 17.9° Aries, Venus at 21.4° Taurus, Mars at 2.6° Libra. Mercury in a fire sign reads as a mind that decides at speaking speed; Venus in a earth sign reads as taste for the substantial and the lasting; Mars in a air sign reads as drive that argues its way forward.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mercury and Pluto — a sextile holding at 0.1°. Sextiles are read as standing invitations — productive exactly as often as they are accepted. Behind it, Mars square Neptune at 1.5°, and the Sun sextile Pluto at 2.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Venus stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, five sit in a sign it has an opinion about. The Sun in Aries at 20.1° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Taurus at 21.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Libra at 2.6° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Pisces at 11.5° is in domicile; Saturn in Aquarius at 8.1° is in domicile. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives air 4, fire 3, water 2, earth 1, and cardinal 5, mutable 3, fixed 2 across the modes. Mars and Uranus were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Libra for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.6° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 9.0°.
